mapper.select:
SELECT t1.uni_id AS "uniId", t1.msg_id AS "msgId", t1.user_id AS "userId", (select s.DICT_LABEL from sys_dict_data s where s.DICT_TYPE = 'sys_msg_type' and s.DICT_VALUE = t1.notify_type) AS "notifyTypeName", t1.notify_title AS "notifyTitle", t1.if_read AS "ifRead", t1.order_status AS "orderStatus", t1.address, t1.creator, DATE_FORMAT(t1.creator_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "creatorDate" FROM vm_message_send_info_t t1 WHERE t1.delete_flag = '1' AND t1.if_read = '0'
AND t1.creator_date >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{startTime}, ' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND t1.creator_date <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND t1.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY t1.creator_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_message_send_info_t ( uni_id, msg_id, user_id, notify_type, notify_title, if_read, order_status, address, creator, creator_date, delete_flag ) VALUES ( #{uniId},#{msgId},#{creator},#{notifyType},#{notifyTitle},'0',#{orderStatus},#{address},#{creator},NOW(),'1' )
mapper.update: UPDATE vm_message_send_info_t SET if_read = '1', modifier = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, modifier_date = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
